findings: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. The user draws the right fist back and thrusts forward, releasing a fast single spirit-energy projectile/hit. Current reference material reports approximately 10% base damage; that value is retained as source-reported rather than patch-independent.
evidence_boundaries: Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
Unsupported exact frames, hidden gates, probabilities, and patch-independent scaling are not promoted.
